logline: 회오리에 실려 낯선 나라에 떨어진 소녀가, 집으로 돌아가려고 노란 벽돌길을 따라간다.
destination: 에메랄드 도시 — 소원을 들어준다는 마법사가 있는 곳
protagonist: 양 갈래로 땋은 머리에 파란 체크 원피스를 입은 소녀
setting: 회오리가 지나간 오즈의 나라, 들판과 숲과 에메랄드 도시
anchor: a young girl with brown braided pigtails, blue gingham dress and red shoes
palette: emerald green, poppy red, cornflower blue, wide prairie gold

beats.beat: 소녀가 회오리에 실린 집 창밖을 내다본다.
beats.visual: a girl at the window of a small wooden house spinning inside a towering tornado, debris circling
beats.motion: the house turns inside the funnel, fences and cows whirl past the window, curtains snap

beats.beat: 소녀가 낯선 들판에 내려선 집 문을 연다.
beats.visual: a girl stepping out of a tilted farmhouse door into a bright land of oversized flowers
beats.motion: the door swings open outward, she steps down into the flowers, petals shake loose

beats.beat: 소녀가 노란 벽돌길 위에 발을 올린다.
beats.visual: a girl setting her red shoe on the first yellow brick of a road curving into hills
beats.motion: her shoe presses down onto the brick, dust puffs up, the road sways with poppies

beats.visual: a straw scarecrow twisting himself off a wooden pole above a cornfield
beats.motion: he wrenches free downward off the pole, straw scatters, crows burst upward

beats.beat: 녹슨 나무꾼이 도끼를 든 채 굳어 있다.
beats.visual: a rusted tin woodman frozen mid-swing with an axe in a dripping forest clearing
beats.motion: rain drips down his rusted joints, the axe head trembles, leaves shake overhead

beats.visual: a huge lion bursting out of roadside bushes onto a yellow brick road, mane flying
beats.motion: the lion leaps out toward the road, bushes whip back, dust bursts under his paws

beats.beat: 에메랄드 도시의 큰 문이 눈앞에서 열린다.
beats.visual: towering green city gates parting before four small travellers, spires glittering beyond
beats.motion: the gates swing inward toward the city, green light spills out, banners flap

beats.beat: 빈 벽돌길에 붉은 구두 자국만 남는다.
beats.visual: an empty yellow brick road at dusk with small shoe prints in the dust, poppies at the verge
beats.motion: dust drifts across the prints, poppies nod at the verge, the road darkens ahead

withheld: 마법사의 정체와, 소녀가 집으로 돌아가는 방법
